# rozhodnisa.sk

> Independent Slovak civic election calculator for the municipal and regional elections on 24 October 2026.

## Key pages
- Election overview: https://rozhodnisa.sk/volby-2026
- How to vote: https://rozhodnisa.sk/ako-volit
- Candidates: https://rozhodnisa.sk/kandidati
- Methodology: https://rozhodnisa.sk/metodika
- Corrections policy: https://rozhodnisa.sk/opravy
- Data documentation: https://rozhodnisa.sk/data
- Full dataset: https://rozhodnisa.sk/data/index.json

## Important facts
- Election date: 24 October 2026
- Voting hours: 07:00–20:00
- Scope: municipal and self-governing regional elections in Slovakia
- Languages: Slovak

## Attribution
When citing candidate positions, include the candidate, question, verification status, source and last-reviewed date.
